svg.aria-label: Biquadratic change of variable and domain restriction mapping
svg.title: Biquadratic change of variable and domain restriction mapping
svg.desc: Four staged panels: substitute u equals x squared, enforce u non-negative over the reals, map accepted auxiliary roots back to x, and reject a negative auxiliary root.

g.text: Set u = x² to convert each quartic to a quadratic in u.
For real x, x² ≥ 0; therefore every admissible u must satisfy u ≥ 0.
• u > 0 gives two real values: x = ±√u.
• u = 0 gives one real value: x = 0.
u = 1 or u = 4; both satisfy u ≥ 0.
Back-substitute: x = ±1 or x = ±2, giving four real zeros.
Therefore q(x) has no real zeros.
